answer: Before an identity may attest, it pledges a storage plot derived from its own public key, and peers challenge three random offsets every epoch. A healthy node reads the pledged bytes and returns a proof whose delta from the committed root stays tiny; a farmer running a thousand puppets needs a thousand physically distinct plots, since a copied plot answers the same offsets and is exposed on the first echo of a challenge. Sharing one crystal of disk buys exactly one voice. What a sybil cannot dodge is hardware and bandwidth held for months.
